Package cafe94.system.controller.staff

Class DriverDashboardController

java.lang.Object
cafe94.system.controller.staff.DriverDashboardController
public class DriverDashboardController extends Object
Controller for the Driver Dashboard in the Cafe94 system.

This dashboard allows logged-in drivers to:

  • View delivery orders assigned to them
  • Mark orders as delivered, updating their status
  • Refresh the order list manually
The controller assigns unassigned delivery orders to the current driver on load, and only displays orders with READY_TO_DELIVER status.

Uses OutstandingOrderHelper for table configuration and DataSaver for saving order updates.
